name: Seafile Sync
author: juangalt
description: Monitor and control Seafile from your Omarchy bar: sync status, pause and snooze, per-library settings, and guided setup.

barWidget.description: Check library status, sync on demand, pause or snooze, adjust sync settings, and open folders or logs.

schema.label: Status refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget checks local status. To change how often a library syncs, open Sync settings in the panel.
